first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus archive-internal DTM tile filenames and Belfast-2006-specific confirmation of the North East Zone coordinate reference system. This unused official Spatial NI Data Supply: Metadata PDF window materially changes method from OpenDataNI/data.gov.uk resource retrieval to Spatial NI CRS guidance and lists Irish Grid (TM65) [EPSG:29902] as the data-supply spatial reference system, but it does not identify the historical Belfast City 2006 LiDAR dataset or prove that its North East Zone uses that CRS; the required PDF page screenshot also returned Cache miss. Therefore EPSG:29902 is retained only as generic Spatial NI guidance and is not promoted to the Belfast tile record; no archive-internal tile filename, geometry, parcel binding or dataset-specific CRS is fabricated.
